title: StructZO: Structured Zeroth-Order Optimization for Memory-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16451v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models at scale is increasingly limited by the memory cost of backpropagation. Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimizers reduce this burden by relying only on forward function evaluations, but they still exhibit a substantial performance gap to first-order (FO) optimizers such as Adam. We argue that this gap does not arise solely from the absence of explicit gradients: FO fine-tuning also benefits from informative low-rank optimization geometry, large-scale signal aggregation, and well-conditioned update directions. Motivated by this, we introduce StructZO, a structured Zeroth-Order optimization framework for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning. StructZO performs large-query ZO estimation within an activation-induced informative subspace and applies spectral control to the resulting reduced-space update before mapping it back to the original parameters. This lets ZO aggregate useful directional signals in a compact, geometry

translated_title: StructZO：面向内存高效大语言模型微调的结构化零阶优化
translated_abstract: 大规模微调大语言模型越来越受到反向传播内存开销的限制。零阶优化器仅依赖前向函数评估来减轻这一负担，但与Adam等一阶优化器相比仍存在显著的性能差距。我们认为这一差距并非仅仅源于缺乏显式梯度：一阶微调还受益于信息丰富的低秩优化几何结构、大规模信号聚合以及条件良好的更新方向。受此启发，我们提出了StructZO，一个用于内存高效大语言模型微调的结构化零阶优化框架。StructZO在由激活诱导的信息子空间内执行大查询零阶估计，并对由此产生的降维空间更新施加谱控制，然后将其映射回原始参数。这使得零阶优化能够在紧凑的、几何…（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: StructZO提出了一种结构化零阶优化框架，通过在激活诱导的信息子空间内进行大查询零阶估计并施加谱控制，有效缩小了零阶优化与Adam等一阶优化器在内存高效大语言模型微调中的性能差距。
en_tdlr: StructZO is a structured zeroth-order optimization framework that performs large-query ZO estimation within an activation-induced informative subspace with spectral control, substantially closing the performance gap between ZO and first-order optimizers for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning.
